# Kimber Sykes — Freelance Executive Producer

> Freelance Executive Producer, Production Manager, and Technical Director based in London. 23 years of experience across 16 countries and seven-figure budgets. Specialising in large-scale corporate events, conferences, summits, and experiential brand activations. Available for contract project leadership across Europe and globally.

## Services

- Executive production for corporate conferences, summits, and product launches
- Experiential and brand activations
- On-site production management, build supervision, and de-rig oversight
- Technical direction, AV delivery, and show flow
- Vendor sourcing, budget management, and project leadership for seven-figure events

## Case studies

- [Google Cloud — Google Cloud Summit 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2026): Google Cloud Summit 2026 returned to Tobacco Dock in London for a third consecutive year under Kimber's production management, bringing Google Cloud's UK customer and partner community together across generative AI, infrastructure, security, and business transformation content.
- [Xero — Xerocon London 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-london-2026): Xerocon London is Xero's flagship UK and Europe conference for the accounting and bookkeeping community, staged at Olympia London over two days in July 2026 for several thousand delegates across keynotes, breakout stages, and an exhibitor floor built around playful, branded activations.
- [Xero — Xerocon Denver 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-denver-2026): Xerocon Denver is Xero's flagship US conference for accounting and bookkeeping professionals, held at the Colorado Convention Center over two days in August 2026.
- [Yoto — Yoto PlayDate London 2026](https://kimbersykes.com/work/yoto-playdate-london-2026): Yoto PlayDate London 2026 was a brand experience event for the children's audio technology company Yoto, staged at the brand's London home to bring its product roadmap and community programmes to life for an invited audience.
- [Google Cloud — Google Cloud Summit 2025](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2025): For Google Cloud Summit 2025 in London, Kimber led production management and technical delivery across nine live conference rooms running in parallel.
- [Google Cloud — Google Cloud Summit 2024](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-cloud-summit-2024): Held at Tobacco Dock in London, Google Cloud Summit 2024 brought together 4,000 attendees over two days to explore the latest advances in generative AI, security, cloud data, and collaboration technologies.
- [Netflix — Stranger Things Fan Experience](https://kimbersykes.com/work/netflix-stranger-things): To launch Season 5 of Stranger Things, Netflix created an immersive fan experience at the historic Cirque d'Hiver in Paris, transporting guests into the world of Hawkins High School.
- [Canva — Canva Studio Pop-Up](https://kimbersykes.com/work/canva-studio): Canva Studio was a pop-up experiential activation in Holborn, Central London, designed to immerse guests in the Canva product through interactive experiences.
- [Geely Auto — EX5 Brand Launch](https://kimbersykes.com/work/geely-auto): Geely Auto's launch into the Australian market was delivered across three connected moments: a media drive day, internal staff training, and the official brand launch at Sydney's Luna Park for 400 guests.
- [Xero — Xerocon Nashville](https://kimbersykes.com/work/xerocon-nashville): Xerocon is Xero's flagship B2B conference for accounting professionals, welcoming around 3,000 attendees from across the United States.
- [Visa — Visa Everywhere Initiative](https://kimbersykes.com/work/visa-everywhere): The Visa Everywhere Initiative is a global innovation program that challenges startups to solve tomorrow's payment problems.
- [Google — Google Pixel 3: Curiosity Rooms](https://kimbersykes.com/work/google-pixel-3): Google Pixel's Curiosity Rooms transformed 55 Regent Street in London into an immersive three-floor experience blending fashion, food, and technology over five weeks.
- [Aperol Spritz — Australian Open](https://kimbersykes.com/work/aperol-spritz): Aperol Spritz was the official aperitif sponsor of the Australian Open 2024.
- [Stella McCartney — Sustainable Market at COP28](https://kimbersykes.com/work/stella-mccartney-cop28): Stella McCartney launched a sustainable innovation exhibit during the COP28 UN Climate Conference in Dubai.
- [Mastercard — UEFA Champions League Final](https://kimbersykes.com/work/mastercard-ucl): On site in Milan for the UEFA Champions League Final, Kimber delivered Mastercard's fan experience activation, including giveaways, priceless surprises, and branded fan-journey touchpoints across the city.
- [Mastercard — British Open Golf](https://kimbersykes.com/work/mastercard-british-open): Mastercard's fan activation at The Open Championship at Royal Troon, Scotland, brought the brand's hospitality and fan-engagement programme on course.
- [MTV — EMA Awards After Party](https://kimbersykes.com/work/mtv-ema): MTV's exclusive EMA Awards after-party at the iconic Wembley Theatre welcomed VIP guests, talent, and A-list media to celebrate MTV's return to London after 12 years.
- [Emirates — Emirates Aviation Experience](https://kimbersykes.com/work/emirates-aviation): The Emirates Aviation Experience is a 500 sqm two-floor interactive museum at Greenwich Peninsula in London, featuring four flight simulators, a large-scale A380 nose cone, a Rolls-Royce Trent 900 engine, and a 360-degree hologram.
- [Emirates — Global Sports Sponsorship Programme](https://kimbersykes.com/work/emirates-sports): Emirates' multi-year global sports sponsorship programme spanned some of the world's most prestigious tournaments.
- [Emirates — Cricket World Cup](https://kimbersykes.com/work/emirates-cricket): On-the-ground production for Emirates' Cricket World Cup sponsorship activation across Australia and New Zealand, delivered as part of the same global sports touring programme as the ATP, PGA, and Commonwealth Games activations.
- [NTT Data — NTT Data: The Open Championship Data Wall](https://kimbersykes.com/work/ntt-data): The NTT Data Wall transformed live R&A tournament data into a fully animated, data-rich visual experience on a large-scale LED screen at The Open Championship, supported by a digital second-screen experience for remote fans.
- [EA Sports — Battlefront II Launch](https://kimbersykes.com/work/ea-sports-battlefront): EA Sports' Battlefront II launch activation at Paris Games Week was a high-traffic public and press showcase staged in a major convention environment.
- [Johnson & Johnson — Mobile Laboratory](https://kimbersykes.com/work/johnson-johnson): A touring laboratory designed and delivered for Johnson & Johnson Medical: a solar-powered trailer featuring a fully equipped laboratory, a conference room, and a VR suite, showcasing the latest robot-assisted knee surgery technology to healthcare professionals across Australia.
- [Expo 2020 — UAE National Day Celebration](https://kimbersykes.com/work/expo-2020): Dubai's Golden Jubilee celebration at Expo 2020 featured content production for a 25,380 sqm projection surface using 252 projectors across 84 video channels.
- [Samsung — Galaxy A5 Launch Tour](https://kimbersykes.com/work/samsung-galaxy-a5): A touring experiential activation promoting the Samsung Galaxy A5, visiting five cities along Australia's east coast.
- [Tourism NT — Parrtjima Festival](https://kimbersykes.com/work/parrtjima): Parrtjima is Australia's only authentic Aboriginal light festival, set against the dramatic backdrop of the MacDonnell Ranges in Alice Springs.
- [Destination NSW — The Long Road](https://kimbersykes.com/work/destination-NSW): Destination NSW's The Long Road campaign with Emotive was delivered as a six-episode TV series, supported by online content and national television distribution.
- [Rizla — Rizlab](https://kimbersykes.com/work/rizla): Rizlab, Experiments in Music, was a brand platform funding the creative visions of pioneering music artists, with a line-up that included Jamie xx, Quayola, Friendly Fires, and Ghostpoet.
- [Aqua Rugby Australia — Darling Harbour Festival](https://kimbersykes.com/work/aqua-rugby): Aqua Rugby Australia is full-contact rugby union played on a 30x30m floating pitch in Darling Harbour, Sydney.
- [Gunpowder Plot — Immersive Theatre Experience](https://kimbersykes.com/work/gunpowder-plot): The Gunpowder Plot is a permanent immersive theatre experience set beneath the Tower of London.
